description: Reconstruct block-0 pre-attention LayerNorm scales and exhaust nearest unions
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 38 prior macro-attempts and 448 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0095/micro-0001 at 1,672 parameters and 99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0095/micro-0002, whose second block-0 pre-FF bias union scored 98.78%. Hypothesis: block 0's pre-attention LayerNorm has local scale redundancy distinct from the bounded pre-FF site; reconstructing its 16 scales from groups and unioning nearest values can reduce count while preserving its two already-fixed zero biases. Ordering is ascending absolute current scale-group difference. This parameterization-preserving normalization substitution is more informative than further pre-FF exclusions because it opens the complementary attention-input site and isolates scales. Each micro-trial adds one scale union and the official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop on the first scored discard or error, at the complete-space cap of 15 micro-trials, or if no pair remains. Compute budget: at most 15 checkpoint migrations and official verifications or 20 wall-clock minutes.
summary: The block-0 pre-attention scale path stopped on its first union. The 1,671-parameter candidate scored 98.90%, so it was discarded and rolled back; frontier remained 1,672 parameters at 99.01%. Outcomes: 0 accepts, 1 scored discard, 0 errors. Compute used one checkpoint migration and official verification over 1m22s wall clock. Stop reason: first scored failure closed this scale path before the 15-trial/20-minute cap.
